triage.desk_query: Term sheet G03 states verbatim: "Coupon amounts accrue on a Actual/360 day count basis." The booking record carries day_count = 30/360, which contradicts the documented Actual/360 basis and will misstate accrued coupon amounts. Please confirm the intended convention is ACT/360 and correct the booking, or identify the executed term that supports 30/360.
triage.cited_clause: Coupon amounts accrue on a Actual/360 day count basis.
triage.rationale: Both extractors agree on an unambiguous term sheet clause specifying Actual/360, so the divergent booking value is the likely error.

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G03 states "Volatility Target 10% per annum" for the underlying index, but the booking record carries index_vol_target_pct = 12. Both extractors independently returned 10 from the term sheet, so the 12 appears to be a booking-side entry. Please confirm the correct volatility target and, if 10% is correct, amend index_vol_target_pct to 10; if the desk traded to a 12% target, identify the amended or superseding term sheet supporting it.
triage.rationale: The term sheet language is explicit and unambiguous with both extractors agreeing on 10, leaving the booking value of 12 as the unsupported figure.
